mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 5% and UNRATE falls > 0.2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases > 200,000 jobs over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a shift towards accommodative policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL rises > 2% YoY
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL rises > 2% YoY.
